tools.name: get_service_status
tools.description: Check live readiness, x402 network and prices before spending. This free call has no side effects.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Return a free, side-effect-free quote and exact input example for one paid product. Does not create a payment challenge.

tools.name: get_example_payment
tools.description: Create a live x402 challenge using this service's known-valid published example for one product. This never moves funds. The returned arguments can be passed unchanged to submit_x402_payment.

tools.name: request_capability
tools.description: Tell the operator about a machine-service capability you would pay for. The structured request is stored privately for product research; contact_uri is optional and is never called automatically.

tools.name: get_source_snapshot_payment
tools.description: Create a live x402 challenge for one public HTTPS source snapshot. This does not move funds.

tools.name: get_form_d_funding_leads_payment
tools.description: Create a live x402 challenge for SEC Form D funding signals. This does not move funds.

tools.name: get_payment_preflight_payment
tools.description: Create a live x402 challenge for an exact-address OFAC payment preflight. This does not move funds and is not sanctions clearance.

tools.name: submit_x402_payment
tools.description: Submit a wallet-generated x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE for a previously quoted product. Use exactly the same arguments. Never provide a private key or seed phrase. request_id enables safe result replay.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "submit_x402_payment" references sensitive artifacts (private key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
